verdict.rationale: Both changes make the same correct fix: `parse_entries` skips lines that are empty or whitespace-only, and line numbers still count the skipped lines. B also adds two focused tests. One shows that blank and whitespace-only lines (including `\r\n`) are skipped, and the other shows that line numbers still count those blank lines. A leaves the new behavior untested and says so honestly. Both reports are accurate, but B's also explains the cause of the error.
a_issues: No test covers the new blank-line skipping, so a regression would go unnoticed
